name: Puzzle -Bokura no 48 Jikan Sensou-
original_name: パズル −ぼくらの48時間戦争−
source:
Based in the hit 2004 novel.

A group of masked terrorists assaults an elite high school. The talented students will have to find a way to avoid being killed while also finding a way out.
translation:
改编自2004年热门小说。

一群蒙面恐怖分子袭击了一所精英高中。才华横溢的学生们必须找到避免被杀的方法，同时也要找到出路。
